context.comment:
Yahoo Japan Corporation (TSE:4689) made an offer to acquire remaining 46.81% stake in Carview Corporation (TSE:2155) from Japan Securities Finance Co. Ltd. (TSE:8511), Microsoft Corporation, Saburo Kikuchi, Motoi Matsumotofor, Shoichi Kaneko and others for ¥5 billion on October 22, 2014. The consideration includes acquisition of 5.7 million shares and 2,740 options. Yahoo Japan Corporation will acquire shares at ¥863 per share for approximately 5.66 million ordinary shares. Minimum number of shares scheduled to be purchased are 2.06 million shares. If Yahoo is unable to acquire all of the common shares, then two step purchases will be made and will make Carview, a wholly owned subsidiary. Yahoo received an approval from Microsoft Corporation to the effect that it has intention to subscribe to the tender offer for the shares held directly and indirectly by the same.

On October 22, 2014, Board of Directors Carview Corporation unanimously approved the offer. The offering period is from October 23, 2014 to December 8, 2014. Carview established a 3rd party committee comprising of independent members. Settlement starts on December 15, 2014. Nomura Securities Co., Ltd. acted as financial advisor and Nagashima Ohno & Tsunematsu acted as legal advisor for Yahoo Japan. A.G.S. Consulting Co., Ltd. acted as financial advisor and City-Yuwa Partners acted as legal advisor for Carview. The purchase commission fee of Nomura Securities is ¥70 million and other fee of Nomura Securities is ¥4 million. Suede One, Inc.(Delaware)는 2021-12-31 기준 Poshmark 자회사 목록(10-K Ex.21.1)에 있으나 NAVER 2023년 1분기보고서의 Poshmark 하위 종속기업 목록(Canada, UK, 호주, 인도 2곳)에는 없다 → 추정: 2022~2023-01 사이 Poshmark에 흡수되거나 청산된 것으로 보이나 이를 직접 밝힌 공시는 찾지 못함. Suede One 자체 재무는 비상장·미공시이고, Poshmark는 영향이 중요하지 않다며 pro forma를 제시하지 않았다. 보도와 보도자료 전문은 Matt Forloine을 'CEO, Suede One'으로만 표기하고(본인 발언 'We built this company'), 설립자 명단은 확인 못 함. 투자 유치 이력도 미확인(보도 5건·CB Insights에 투자 정보 없음, SEC EDGAR 전문검색상 Suede One 명의 Form D 0건). 보도자료 전문은 'The Suede One team will join the Poshmark team, effective today'(2021-10-13)라고 적어 10-Q의 완료일 2021-10-12와 하루 차이가 있다. 법적 완료일은 SEC 공시(10-Q·10-K)의 2021-10-12를 따른다. 시가총액: 발표 직전 거래일(2021-10-12) POSH 일별 종가를 무료 출처에서 확보하지 못해(Yahoo 차트 API·Nasdaq API는 상장폐지 종목 데이터 없음, stooq·MarketWatch는 봇 차단, 2021-10 Form 4 없음) 월간 시세 기반 추정치만 적었다. 재무 수치 주의: Poshmark 10-K 2021은 과거 재무제표를 정정했다(Note 3, chargeback 등 비중요 오류). 2020-12-31 총자산 285,434→288,502천, 2020 순매출 262,077→261,601천, 2021-09-30 자본 418,235→422,417천(10-Q 3Q22). 이 기록의 규모 지표는 발표 당시 공시돼 있던 원 수치(10-Q 3Q21) 기준이다. 조사 범위: SEC EDGAR(CIK 0001825480) 10-Q 3Q21·10-K 2021·Ex.21.1·10-Q 2Q22·3Q22·실적 8-K 2건·DEFM14A, EDGAR 전문검색('Suede One' 17건), NAVER DART 2023-1Q 분기보고서, 업계 보도 6건(보도자료 전문 포함), CB Insights, Motley Fool 어닝콜 녹취록 4건(3Q21·4Q21·1Q22·2Q22).

Under the agreement, Naver will acquire all of the issued and outstanding shares of Poshmark for $17.90 in cash, representing an enterprise value of approximately $1.2 billion, assuming $436 million of unrestricted cash on balance sheet as of June 30, 2022. The transaction is expected to be funded with Naver’s cash balances and other existing financing sources. Upon completion of the transaction, Poshmark will become a standalone U.S. subsidiary of Naver and will continue to be led by Founder and Chief Executive Officer Manish Chandra and Poshmark’s current management team. Poshmark will pay a termination fee of $52.913 million to NAVER, in case Poshmark terminates the transaction. Poshmark will continue to operate under its existing brand, as well as maintain its employee base, Poshmark community, and headquarters in Redwood City, California.

The transaction is subject to approval by Poshmark stockholders, expiration or termination of any applicable waiting periods under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act and the satisfaction of certain other customary closing conditions. The transaction is not contingent on any financing. The transaction was unanimously approved by both Naver’s and Poshmark’s Boards of Directors. Naver has secured voting and support agreements with certain stockholders of Poshmark, representing approximately 77% of the outstanding voting power of Poshmark common shares. The special meeting of Poshmark is scheduled on December 27, 2022. The transaction has been approved by the shareholders of Poshmark on December 27, 2022, The transaction is expected to close by the first quarter of 2023. As of December 27, 2022, the transaction is expected to close in early January 2023. The acquisition is expected to be accretive to go-forward growth with clear path to profitability and is expected to generate significant revenue and cost synergies, consisting primarily of re-acceleration of annual revenue growth beyond 20% in the near-term by leveraging Naver’s advertising capabilities and approximately $30 million in run-rate annual cost savings within 24 months post-closing.
